seed_fields.description: Construct transverse centers and radii with explicit regulation. Points and tangents are aligned finite float64 (N,3); pitch is (N,), in the same caller-defined length unit as points. Tangents are dimensionless and need not be unit vectors. minimum_axial is positive and dimensionless; maximum_scale is positive with length units. The axial tangent component is floored in magnitude (zero uses positive sign), then -pitch/(2*pi*axial) is clipped to maximum_scale. Regulation can change the input tangent direction; rescaling tangents can change regulated results. Returns centers (N,2) and nonnegative radii (N,). Empty batches allowed. No detector policy is embedded. Nonfinite intermediates reject before clipping can conceal overflow.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (N,3), caller-defined length units. Empty batches allowed. For a unit oriented tangent, caller must supply points on the transverse circles.

interfaces.name: tangents
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 matrix (N,3), dimensionless, not necessarily unit vectors. Regulation may change direction and destroys scale invariance near its thresholds.

interfaces.name: pitch
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 vector (N,), signed axial length per revolution in the same units as points.

interfaces.name: minimum_axial
interfaces.constraints: Positive finite real scalar, dimensionless. Floors axial tangent magnitude; zero uses positive sign. Caller selects this regularization policy.

interfaces.name: maximum_scale
interfaces.constraints: Positive finite real scalar in point length units. Clips the construction scale magnitude after finite division. Caller selects this regularization policy.

interfaces.name: centers
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 transverse centers (N,2), in point length units.

interfaces.name: radius
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite nonnegative float64 radii (N,), in point length units.

seed_fields.description: Evaluate an oriented tangent using supplied helix geometry. Finite float64 points (N,3), centers (N,2), and vectors radius, pitch and axial_direction (N,) must align. Coordinates, nonnegative radii and signed pitch per revolution share caller-defined length units. Caller must supply points on each transverse circle; only then is the result a unit vector. Only the sign of axial_direction is used. Its product with pitch must be finite and nonzero. Empty batches allowed; nonfinite arithmetic rejects. Returns float64 (N,3). No unit normalization of inconsistent geometry, coordinate conversion, detector topology or physical field model is supplied.

interfaces.name: points
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 matrix (N,3), caller-defined length units. Empty batches allowed. For a unit oriented tangent, caller must supply points on the transverse circles.

interfaces.name: centers
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 transverse centers (N,2), in point length units.

interfaces.name: radius
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite nonnegative float64 radii (N,), in point length units.

interfaces.name: pitch
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 vector (N,), signed axial length per revolution in the same units as points.

interfaces.name: axial_direction
interfaces.constraints: Aligned finite float64 vector (N,). Only its sign is used; product with pitch must be finite and representably nonzero.

interfaces.name: tangent
interfaces.constraints: Finite float64 oriented tangent matrix (N,3). Unit length only when supplied points lie on their transverse circles; inconsistent geometry is not normalized.

limitations: Draft source/interface intake only; semantic publication and dependency gates remain.
Generic helix geometry; units and regularization are caller supplied. Detector selection and cell-direction policy stay in the recipe.
